professionalSummary.text: Technical project manager with two years of experience leading the data platform migration for a software company, running five workstreams under the company's delivery method including migration plan and cut-over schedule.
professionalSummary.witness: Technical project manager on the data platform migration of a software company for two years, running the migration's five workstreams under the company's delivery method with the migration plan and the cut-over schedule.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared weekly steering reports for the head of data platform, filed with steering decisions in the migration folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed dependencies with four data engineering teams and three analytics teams through the dependency register, escalating two blocked dependencies to steering meetings.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared cut-over readiness reviews for eleven cut-overs, recording cut-over approval by head of data platform and delineating responsibility boundaries.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the cut-over readiness review for each of the eleven cut-overs; the cut-over approval was the head of data platform's, recorded on the readiness review, which also records which checks were mine and which the engineering teams'.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented workstream boundaries and acceptance evidence in closure reports signed by analytics team leads.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the closure report for each workstream with the workstream boundary statement and the acceptance evidence signed by the analytics team leads.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Migration plan with cut-over schedule, weekly steering report, cut-over readiness review with approval record, and workstream closure report, all with migration folder references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the migration plan with its cut-over schedule, one weekly steering report, one cut-over readiness review with the approval record and one workstream closure report, with the migration folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Delivery method expertise, dependency management, cut-over readiness, acceptance evidence documentation.
skills.witness: Technical project manager on the data platform migration of a software company for two years, running the migration's five workstreams under the company's delivery method with the migration plan and the cut-over schedule.
